messages:
Maria Gomez: quick follow-up from the staging RFC — thinking about a checkpoint-manifest + chunked-delta flow for air-gapped/on‑prem nodes. brain dump below, want quick sanity checks :thinking_face:

Jay Patel: SG. main concern: dual-rootfs approaches are heavy for tiny edge devices. we need low storage overhead.

Oliver Chen: idea: two-phase apply but keep chunk storage outside rootfs (e.g., /var/lib/rw-chunks). stage everything into an overlay, verify, then atomic switch of symlink for /opt/app -> /opt/app.active. rollback marker lives next to symlink. sample manifest snippet:```
manifest:
  version: "2"
  checkpoints:
    - id: "sha256:4a7f..."
      chunks: ["c1", "c2", "c3"]
  signature: "sig-v1"
  rotate-after: "90d"
```

Rajesh Kumar: signature rotation note: customers using KMS/HSM will need a verifier key in the installer. propose signer+verifier role separation and pin a chain-of-trust blob in the bootstrap image for offline installs. rotation window 90d, fallback to archived keys for upgrades up to 12 months.

Sara Liu: resumable transfer is non-negotiable for intermittent networks. use content-addressable chunks + simple index.json so the transport can be a dumb SCP/HTTP mirror that supports range requests. verify per-chunk sha256 after receive.

infra-bot: deploybot: preflight checklist: checksum verification, manifest signature, rollback marker presence, staged-healthcheck.

Maria Gomez: another worry: partial apply could cause mixed-version serving (binary A + plugin B mismatch). two-phase staging then atomic switch mitigates this. also keep previous symlink for N hours (48h) to allow immediate fallbacks.

Jay Patel: database migrations are the real landmine. recommend migrations be explicitly gated in manifest with a "migration": {"kind": "preflight|migrate", "dry_run": true/false} field. no automatic schema apply unless the deployment is labeled canary or operator-approved.

Oliver Chen: agreed. manifest example for migration:```
migration:
  id: "2026-02-add-user-index"
  required_services: ["userdb"]
  dry_run: true
  canary_allowed: true
```

Maria Gomez: action items: (1) PoC chunked-delta tool by EOW — @Oliver, (2) KMS/key-rotation design note — @Rajesh, (3) installer chain-of-trust & pin behavior doc — @Sara. I'll open a follow-up RFC that captures staged apply + migration gating + resume semantics. :thumbsup:
